meanings.translation: second/third-person singular dependent-clause present indicative of aandoen

canonical_example.text: Mijn moeder kwam op de fiets aangereden.
Mijn moeder is gister aangereden door de bus.
canonical_example.translation: My mother was hit by the bus yesterday.

canonical_example.text: Mijn moeder is net naar huis aangereden.
canonical_example.translation: My mother just left for home.

canonical_example.text:
1637, Statenvertaling, Genesis 1,1.
In den beginne schiep God de hemel en de aarde.
canonical_example.translation: In the beginning, God made the heaven and the earth.

canonical_example.text: Getuigen meldden dat de vrouw door één voertuig is geschept en door twee andere voertuigen is geraakt.
canonical_example.translation: Witnesses reported that the woman was shovelled up in the air by one car and was then hit by two other cars.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to hit and subsequently heave up (by a vehicle at high speed)

meanings.translation: stoop, platform before a (major) door into a building, doorstep
organic; produced without chemical pest control (of food)
a teacher, a person who gives lessons

canonical_example.text: Weet u niet dat wij over engelen zullen oordelen?
canonical_example.translation: Do you not know that we will judge angels?

unused_menu_senses.translation: judgment, verdict, decision, sentence (legal conclusion in a court of law)
opinion, judgement (conclusion of an act of deciding)

canonical_example.text: Ze zocht naar tekenen van leven in het verlaten gebied.
canonical_example.translation: She looked for signs of life in the abandoned area.

canonical_example.text: De letters van het alfabet zijn tekens die samen woorden vormen.
canonical_example.translation: The letters of the alphabet are symbols that form words together.

canonical_example.text: Als God niet wou dat we wormen in gingen snuiven, had Hij ze niet cilindervormig gemaakt!
canonical_example.translation: If God didn't want us to snort worms, He wouldn't have made them cylindrical!

meanings.translation: worm, vernacular term for various, mostly legless invertebrates; often nematodes or legless arthropod larvae.

canonical_example.text: De eenzaamheid overviel haar na het verlies van haar partner.
canonical_example.translation: Loneliness overwhelmed her after the loss of her partner.
